attributes.name: Svendack
attributes.powers:
Before you act, each character at your location must succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 12 check or be dealt 2d4 Fire damage.

While you act, when you are dealt damage by Svendack, discard cards from the top of your deck instead of your hand.

If defeated, you may shuffle Svendack into a random other open location to immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
